# Image

`ui.image` · parts: `Image`, `Picture`, `Source` · elements: `<img>`, `<picture>`, `<source>`

## Purpose

Image renders img, picture, and source. Alt is required; pass an empty
string for decorative images.

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
- `alt` is required (use `alt=""` for decorative images).
- Art direction: `Picture` with `Source` children and an `Image` fallback.
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

## Image

Image renders an img element; alt is always emitted.

### Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Src` | `src` | `src` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Alt` | `alt` | `alt` | `string` (required) | — | prop | alternative text; empty string for decorative images |
| `SrcSet` | `srcSet` | `srcset` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Sizes` | `sizes` | `sizes` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Width` | `width` | `width` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Height` | `height` | `height` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Loading` | `loading` | `loading` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Decoding` | `decoding` | `decoding` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in UI frameworks, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins).

### Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

### Children

Void / self-contained element: children are not accepted.

### ARIA

- No ARIA attributes are rendered by the primitive; rely on native semantics. Pass extra `aria-*` through attrs.

### Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `imageClasses({ ... })` from `image/image.shared.ts` |
| templ | `image.ImageClasses(image.ImageProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('imageClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::imageClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `image_classes(p)` |

### Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<img alt="">` |
| img | `{"Src":"/a.png","Alt":"A cat","Width":"64","Height":"64","Loading":"lazy","Decoding":"async"}` | `<img src="/a.png" alt="A cat" width="64" height="64" loading="lazy" decoding="async">` |
| decorative | `{"Src":"/b.png","Alt":""}` | `<img src="/b.png" alt="">` |
| source | `{"SrcSet":"/a.webp","Sizes":"100vw"}` | `<img alt="" srcset="/a.webp" sizes="100vw">` |

### Usage

Fixture `img` (`{"Src":"/a.png","Alt":"A cat","Width":"64","Height":"64","Loading":"lazy","Decoding":"async"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<img src="/a.png" alt="A cat" width="64" height="64" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx

<Image alt="A cat" src="/a.png" width="64" height="64" loading="lazy" decoding="async" />
```

## Picture

Picture wraps Source candidates and a fallback Image.

### Props

_No typed props (only class / attrs / children)._

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in UI frameworks, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins), children.

### Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

### Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

### ARIA

- No ARIA attributes are rendered by the primitive; rely on native semantics. Pass extra `aria-*` through attrs.

### Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `pictureClasses({ ... })` from `image/image.shared.ts` |
| templ | `image.PictureClasses(image.PictureProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('pictureClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::pictureClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `picture_classes(p)` |

### Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<picture>Content</picture>` |

### Usage

Fixture `defaults` (`{}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<picture>Content</picture>
```

## Source

Source renders a source candidate inside picture.

### Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |

| `SrcSet` | `srcSet` | `srcset` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Media` | `media` | `media` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Type` | `type` | `type` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Sizes` | `sizes` | `sizes` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |

Also accepts: extra attributes (rest props in UI frameworks, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins).
